physical.material: Steel/SPCC backbone and cover, plastic fingers

configs.description: The finger duct as FS ships #220085, cover fitted.
configs.name: base

gaps.note: no FS document held states a cable capacity for CMH-SFDS1U: the datasheet that covers it has no Cable Capacity Reference Guide, and the cable managers portfolio lists only dimensions. The product page could not be read (403 from the shop front).
gaps.wanted: the capacity row of the product page, or a capacity table in a later datasheet
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - style, sides, backbone and cover material, colour and the detachable cover are the specification table of the FS Horizontal Cable Managers with Finger Duct datasheet (steel, portal id 6867), which also says the part is made of SPCC and plastic; RoHS and ISO 9001 are its Standards Compliance list. The four screws and cage nuts are step 1 of the FS Horizontal Cable Managers quick start guide V1.0 for CMH-SFDS1U and CMH-DFDS2U.

bottom.note: drawing - the bottom row of fingers is the top row again; the front view draws the clips staggered but the fingers in line.

capacity.note: not stated - no capacity is carried: the steel finger duct datasheet has no capacity table and the cable managers portfolio gives dimensions only, so the figure is the `cable-capacity` gap below, not a datasheet fact.

chassis.note: drawing - THE BODY BETWEEN THE EARS. The drawing gives 483.00 over the ears and 440.00 for the cover; the backbone runs flat into the ears, 21.5 mm each, which are not drawn. Height 51.00 is the cover, dimensioned on the front view, and the end view measures 51.7 across the cover; the ears are 43.60 and the backbone 44, centred. The FS product page height of 44.45 is the rack unit, not the part. Depth 113.3 is the end view overall, cover included, and the spec table states 113.3 and 106; 106 is the backbone to the finger tips on the plan.

color.note: estimated - Color: Black. Every image FS publishes of the part is a render; the cover reads a median of 39 on each channel on gallery image 1 and the back of the backbone 27 on gallery image 4.

fingers.note: drawing - ten fingers a row. The plan draws their stems 69.6 px apart, 44.4 mm, and five two-finger mouldings 443.5 over all; ten at 44.4 would run past the 440 cover, so the pitch is taken as 44.0 and the row fills the body between the ears, 0.4 mm a pitch short of the drawing. A finger is a stem 10.2 wide and a T head 39.4 wide, leaving a 4.6 neck between heads. On the plan the stem forks into two legs that meet the moulded block 28 mm from the back; the fork is drawn as the stem running straight to the block. The square windows in the blocks are not drawn.

front.note: drawing - the cover, fitted, as the front view of the drawing draws it: 440 x 51 with four hinge clips, two on the top edge and two on the bottom, staggered. The fingers stand in two rows 9.0 thick, 4.7 in from the top and bottom of the cover, read off the end view, which draws the two finger walls 14 px thick with their outer faces 66 px apart. The `duct` guide is the 23.6 mm between the rows.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the backbone is the mounting plane and the duct stands 113.3 mm in front of it (the side view of the datasheet), so the rear face of its rack unit stays free for another part.

guides.note: drawing - the duct on the front view is the channel between the finger rows, run across the rack; finger pitch 44.0 and the 33.8 between stems, from the plan.

left.note: drawing - the end view: the backbone, the two finger rows 9 thick with 23.6 between them, and the cover across the heads. The hinge knuckles on the heads are drawn as the heads. The duct is open at both ends.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE VENDOR DRAWING. The FS Horizontal Cable Managers with Finger Duct datasheet (steel, portal id 6867) carries a technical drawing of CMH-SFDS1U: the back, a plan, an end view and the front, with dimensions in millimetres. The embedded image (1228 x 770) is 1.567 px/mm across the 483 and the 440, 1.566 down the 106 and 1.571 down the 113.3: it is orthographic and carries geometry to about a millimetre. The renders of #220085 on the FS product page are the second reading, one of them a straight-on view of the back.

rear.note: drawing - the back of the backbone from the back view of the drawing: three obround pass-through holes 216 px long, 137.8 mm, and 28 px high, 17.9, 19 px apart, running 1.3 mm short of each end of the body, centred on the backbone. The straight -on render of the back (gallery image 4) confirms three holes and the fingers seen through them. The sunk plates round the holes are rectangles; the holes in the floor in front of them keep their round ends.

shell.note: drawing - A HOLLOW DUCT. The body is a sheet body and its six views are elevations. The solid is what its parts build: the backbone on the front view as a well 111.3 deep whose floor is the backbone and is open at the three pass-through holes; the two rows of fingers standing in it; and the cover across the finger heads, which comes off and opens the channel. The rear view builds the back of the backbone as sunk plates round the holes. The channel and its two ends are open air.

thickness.note: estimated - no FS document states the gauge of the SPCC backbone or cover. 1.2 is taken, the gauge of the other FS steel managers in the library; the plan draws the backbone edge two pixels thick, 1.3 mm.

top.note: drawing - the plan, rear at y=0: the backbone, the moulded blocks to 28, the stems, the heads from 96.4 and the cover edge at the front. Open air between the fingers is drawn dark.

weight.note: datasheet - 1.04 kg, the FS product page specification for #220085, as read at intake; the datasheet states no weight.
